notes:
### Onboarding (P0)

**O1 — MT5 credential form.** New section in Profile → Connected Brokers with inputs for account number, password, and broker server, plus a single "Save & Test" button that persists via `/api/config` and immediately calls `/api/onboarding/test-broker` to attempt a real broker connection. Test result + connected MT5 login (e.g. `#12345678`) display inline. Password is encrypted at rest via the V14 master-key Fernet path; the form deliberately does NOT prefill the password field on load — empty submit means "leave previous value as-is" so the encrypted ciphertext is never round-tripped through the client.

**O2 — Paper-trade default for fresh installs.** New `paper_trade_mode` flag in user config, default `true`. `place_market_order` and `place_limit_order` short-circuit through the same synthetic-ticket path that `test_mode` already uses — the rest of the engine pipeline (state machine, daily counters, `log_trade_event`, audit log) runs end-to-end so the user gets a faithful preview of what would happen in live trading. Bright amber banner across the top of the dashboard ("PAPER TRADING — no real orders will be placed") whenever the flag is on. Switching to live requires typing "I understand" into a hard-confirm prompt; switching back to paper is a single click.

**O3 — Bug-report channel.** "Report a problem" button in the tray app footer. Opens the user's default mail client via `mailto:support@tradespace.app` with the subject pre-filled to include the app version and the body seeded with auto-collected context (version, platform, locale, UTC timestamp, user-agent). Test users always have a clear feedback path; full server-side ingest with redacted log-tail upload is deferred to a later release.

### Tests
- 141/141 tests pass (test_database, test_live_pnl, test_metrics, test_history_range, test_core_bugs).
- Manual verification: `paper_trade_mode` default `True` fires the synthetic-ticket path on every signal; toggling to live and back round-trips through `/api/config` cleanly. MT5 form's Save & Test calls land on the existing `/api/onboarding/test-broker` endpoint.
